strings.그대가 나를 그냥 지나칠 수도 있었는데, 찾아오는 걸 보면 분명 뭔가 느: You could have walked right past me. If you came to see me, you must have sensed something.
I'm not sure. I just felt as though I should speak to you, Geis...
There is no need to puzzle over it alone. She has guided it all.
The one who has become everything to you on your journey.
The goddess is waiting. Go now, to the Frozen World...
All right. I'll see you next time.
strings.그대가 있었군. 무슨 일이지. 이 안까지 좀처럼 들어오는 일은 없을 텐데: Oh, you're here. What brings you? You rarely come this far inside.
%s has entered the Frozen World, then.
An heir of Carion has every right to know.
I still think it may be too soon...
strings.여전히 그대는 나와 생각이 다르군. 그 목걸이를 레다 님께 받을 때도 그: As ever, you and I disagree. Just as we did when you received that necklace from Lady Leda...
Let us hope the necklace's choice does not bring misfortune.
Iris... I heard you called for me.
strings.혹시 여행을 시작할 때를 기억하시나요?: Do you remember when your journey began?
I arrived in Belos and read your memories at a stone monument.
Oh, I... I was in Lumen...
strings.(이리스가 손을 뻗어 이마를 만진다. 잠시 후, 따뜻한 기운이 온 몸으로: (Iris reaches out and touches your forehead. A moment later, warmth spreads through your body.)
strings.(제나디아에서의 일과는 다른 기억….): (A different memory from what happened in Xenadia...)
I was... What I mean is...
strings.카리온 백작가의 후계자, %s…. 데이모스 교단의 습격으로 영지가 그들의: %s, heir to the House of Count Carion... The Order of Deimos attacked, and your family's lands fell into their hands.
strings.백작님께선 후계자인 당신을 지키기 위해 교단과 맞서 싸우셨어요. 그리고: The count fought the Order to protect you, his heir. Then he entrusted you to Ull, Lord Ziskad's disciple.
strings.그래, 맞아. 내가 가지고 있던 것이 무너지던 밤, 난 울의 도움으로 루: That's right. On the night everything I had fell apart, Ull helped me escape to Lumen.
strings.강해지려고, 강해지려고 끝도 없이 노력했지만, 쉽지 않았어. 그래서 지스: I tried endlessly to grow stronger, but it wasn't easy. So I asked Lord Ziskad to take me as his disciple, but he refused.
Then, on Ull's advice, I set out on a journey...
strings.이리스…, 나는 왜 이걸 잊고 있었지? 기억을 잃은 거야?: Iris... Why had I forgotten all this? Did I lose my memory?
strings.아니에요. 기억을 떠올린 게 아니고, 뭔가가 모두를 막고 있었던 것뿐이에: No. It's not that you have recovered lost memories. Something was simply preventing everyone from remembering.
That's why I called you. Both you and I need to understand it, %s.
strings.어렵지 않은 일이에요. 가이아 님의 처소에서 '환영의 씨앗'을 찾아서 가: It isn't difficult. Would you find an Illusion Seed in Gaia's dwelling and bring it to me? It is different from the Illusion Tree Seed that Tractus carries.
All right... I'll be back soon.
strings.기다렸어요. 이게 환영의 씨앗…. 가이아 님께서도 환영의 씨앗이 %s에게: I've been waiting. So this is the Illusion Seed... Gaia also hopes it will help you, %s.
strings.가이아 님께서? 이리스는 어떻게 알고 있는 거야?: Gaia does? How do you know, Iris?
Since inheriting the celestial deity's power from Seres, I've come to understand certain things.
strings.그래서 이야기하려 해요. 이제 조금씩 %s 앞에 나가고 싶으니까요. 자,: That's why I want to tell you. Little by little, I want to step forward and face you, %s. Now, look...
strings.(이리스의 손에 있던 환영의 씨앗이 녹아 사라진다.): (The Illusion Seed melts away in Iris's hand.)
strings.이제 조금 알 것 같아요. 당신에게 주어진 힘, 그 힘이 당신을 막고 있: I think I understand now. The power you were given was holding you back.
The only power I have is something like a divine blessing...
strings.(눈을 감고 조금 기다려보니 알 수 없는 잔상이 떠오른다.): (You close your eyes and wait a moment. Unfamiliar images begin to surface.)
strings.바이스…. 바이스가 뭔가를 원하고 있어. 잠깐, 나에게 바이스가 원하는: Weiss... Weiss wants something. Wait, I have the power he's after?
The power of House Carion... That's why the Order of Deimos came after me and everyone else...
strings.카리온 가에겐 말로 설명할 수 없는 그런 힘이 있었어요. 그게 바이스에게: House Carion possessed a power that cannot easily be put into words. Perhaps Weiss needed it. So, as he always does...
I'm fine. Please keep going. Don't stop...
strings.오래전에 이스트랜드에 머물렀던 뒤틀린 자들의 영향이 어떤 사람들에게 있었: It seems the Twisted Ones who stayed in Eastland long ago left an influence on certain people. A kind of power.
strings.비록 초인 같은 힘은 아닐지라도, 카리온 가의 후계자에게는 그런 힘이 대: It may not be a Champion's power, but it has passed down through the heirs of House Carion for generations. In the very form Weiss desires...
strings.그걸 완성하기 위해서 원했을지도 몰라요…. 하지만, 지금 그는 기억하지: Perhaps he wanted it to complete that... But now, he no longer remembers. The power has protected you so that you can become a true Chaser, %s.
strings.세레스 님과 가이아님의 가호, 그리고 제가 초인들을 통해 받은 힘의 흔적: The blessings of Seres and Gaia, the traces of power I received through the Champions, and the power of Carion within you all reacted together, %s.
strings.세계의 모든 강한 존재의 영향을 따로 받지 않기 위해…. 특히 바이스에게: To shield you from the influence of the world's powerful beings... Weiss in particular...
strings.지금 바이스는 자신과 마주하고 있는 사람이 카리온 가의 후계라고 생각지: Right now, Weiss does not realize that the person standing before him is the heir to House Carion.
strings.%s, 당신을 바이스에게서만 보호하면 좋겠지만, 알고 지낸 루맨의 사람: I wish it had only protected you from Weiss, %s, but it also affected the people you knew in Lumen.
Oh, so that's what happened. They didn't feel like strangers...
You're welcome. But I'm not the one you should thank. That would be Lord Ziskad...
If you get the chance, speak with him yourself. Hehe...
strings.아! %s, 유란님이 찾고 있는데 가보시겠어요?: Oh! %s, Yuran is looking for you. Would you go see him?
strings.날 찾는다고? 흐음, 무슨 일일까…. 이리스, 그럼 나중에 좋은 모습으로: Looking for me? Hmm, I wonder why... Iris, let's meet properly someday, when things are better. I'll look forward to it.
I heard you were looking for me.
strings.%s 님을 찾으려고 했지만, 누군가한테 이야기하진 않았습니다. 심상세계에: I was going to look for you, %s, but I hadn't told anyone. You've been to the Illusory World, then.
strings.별 건 아니고 스승님께서 자리를 마련해달라고 하셨습니다. 저는 잠시 물러: It's nothing serious. My master asked me to arrange a meeting. I'll step aside for a moment so you can speak.
Ah, it's a pleasure to meet you...
A pleasure, heir of Carion... Thank you for holding on all this time.
strings.오늘 만남 이후 다시 자네를 처음 본 사람처럼 대할지도 모르겠네. 그건: After today's meeting, I may treat you as someone I've never met again. You know why, so let me ask your understanding in advance.
strings.어느 정도는 이리스 여신님께 들어서 알고 있겠지…? 내가 카리온 백작령을: The goddess Iris has probably told you something of it...? I should have paid closer attention to the Carion estate. I'm sorry I failed to do so.
strings.울이 병력을 이끌고 자네를 비롯해 생존자들 몇을 데리고 나오긴 했지만,: Ull led a force in and brought you and a few other survivors out. That was the best we could do.
Tell Ull that, rather than me. Ull truly cared about you...
strings.그때를 생각하면 가슴이 답답해지는군. 백작령이 무너졌을 때, 내 고향의: Thinking back on that time weighs heavily on me. When the estate fell, it reminded me of what happened to my homeland...
strings.자네가 지금까지 잘 버텨줘서 정말 고맙네. 힘에 집착하지 않는 모습 또한: I'm truly grateful that you've persevered. I also commend you for no longer being consumed by the pursuit of power.
strings.제자가 되겠다고 무작정 달려들던 그 모습도 사라지고, 이제 여신을 따르는: The person who once rushed in and demanded to become my disciple is gone. I'm glad to see you reborn as a follower of the goddess.
strings.하여튼, 이 말을 전하러 왔지. 고마웠네. 앞으로도 잘 부탁하지. 앞으로: That is what I came to say. Thank you. I will continue to count on you. Many more difficult trials lie ahead...
strings.이제 난 돌아가지. 기억하지 못한다 해도 아쉬워하지 말게. 그리고 나중에: I should return now. Don't be disheartened if I cannot remember you. And when all of this is over, come see me again.
Perhaps by then, I will be able to remember...
All right. I'll be on my way as well.
(Power of Carion, thank you... You cut me off from everyone to keep me safe...)
strings.(그래, 모두가 잊어도 나는 기억하니까. 이 기억으로 이리스를 계속 따라: (Yes. Even if everyone else forgets, I remember. I'll hold on to these memories and keep following Iris.)
strings.(비록 다른 이들이 기억하지 못한다고 이야기하지도, 섭섭해 하지도 않을: (I won't tell people that they have forgotten me, or resent them for it.)
Master, when did you arrive? I thought you would be back later this time.
strings.그래, 유란. 내 할 일이 있어 빨리 왔다. 그동안 별일 없었지?: Ah, Yuran. I had something to do, so I returned early. Has all been well?
